data.gender_notes: Baliveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Baliveer is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' meaning power and 'Iver' meaning protector. This name signifies a powerful and brave individual who is a protector of the gods. The name Baliveer carries the meaning “Powerful, Brave, God Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baliveer usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, brave, god protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name is also indicative of the deeply ingrained tradition of valuing bravery and protection within the Hindu society.

During this time, Baliveer was the chief minister of the king and is known to have played a significant role in the administration and military campaigns of the Solanki kingdom.
